item.title: Medtronic to Buy CathWorks for $585M
item.description: Four years ago, CathWorks and Medtronic plc, one of the world’s largest medical device makers, struck up a co-promotion agreement with the option for Medtronic to buy the Irvine-based cardiac-focused device maker within five years.
